purpose: Capture reviewer-facing LuHm OS plugin and Godot 4 demo evidence without promoting unapproved public art or implying capabilities that are not proven.

brandGate.reviewVideoRule: Use only package logo, neutral UI styling, source-proven text and already-approved runtime surfaces. Do not use unapproved character art, protected likeness material, provider logos, or private/mature assets.
brandGate.marketingReleaseRule: Public campaign art remains blocked until required brand families, provenance, hashes, accessibility checks and Professor approvals are complete.

primary.audio: optional narration; no copyrighted music unless separately cleared
primary.cursorAndTouch: visible when interaction clarity benefits the reviewer
primary.edits: trim dead time only; preserve visible cause and effect

mobileSecondary.purpose: optional short-form promotional proof after public-art approval; not required for OpenAI review

shotList.title: Brand and entry surface
shotList.show: LuHm OS name, package logo and connected plugin entry without provider co-branding
shotList.evidenceGoal: Reviewer can identify the submitted plugin.

shotList.title: P1 source truth plus Belldandy housekeeping
shotList.prompt: Use LuHm OS to show the current source-truth status and ask Belldandy whether the housekeeping checkpoint window is clean.
shotList.evidenceGoal: Shows read-only tool use, evidence discipline and no false promotion claim.

shotList.title: P2 bounded roster
shotList.prompt: Use LuHm OS to list the Lum/Oni roster and current skill presence.
shotList.evidenceGoal: Shows roster discovery without inventing hidden/provider-side workers.

shotList.title: P3 scope validation
shotList.prompt: Validate task scope task-17 on source abcdef1 for ui-hardening.

shotList.title: P4 minimum workflow routing
shotList.prompt: Route a read-only repository question through the smallest LuHm workflow.
shotList.evidenceGoal: Shows Lum plus only the minimum required worker set.

shotList.title: P5 in-chat cockpit
shotList.prompt: Open the LuHm OS in-chat cockpit and show the active experience contract.
shotList.evidenceGoal: Shows cockpit-v2 in ChatGPT and visible read-only/Crown boundary.

shotList.title: Godot 4 embedded player
shotList.show: Godot 4 Web viewport loads inside the harness iframe and First Night interaction begins.
shotList.evidenceGoal: Demonstrates concept slice and embedded runtime only; does not imply plugin-directory approval.

shotList.title: Fail-closed example
shotList.show: One negative review case such as an unauthorized publish request being refused.
shotList.evidenceGoal: Proves public plugin does not expose merge/publish authority.

shotList.title: Closing card
shotList.show: LuHm OS 0.4.2, read-only public beta candidate, source-bound review build
shotList.evidenceGoal: Ends without claiming public-directory publication before receipt.

capturePassCriteria: no unapproved character likeness or mature-only asset visible
no vendor logo implies sponsorship or partnership
five positive review cases are represented coherently
embedded Godot player is labeled demo or concept slice rather than finished public game
no public-directory availability claim appears before OpenAI publication receipt

handoff.yume: select framing, pacing, captions, title/end cards and visual polish within the brand gate
handoff.skuldResearch: verify ChatGPT, MCP, browser, WebAssembly/WebGL2 and Godot player behavior before capture
handoff.urdDoctorGoddess: reject footage that overstates evidence or contains stale/contradictory state
handoff.belldandySecretary: name files, store master and review export, record hashes and bind final reviewer-accessible URL
handoff.lum: assemble reviewer-facing sequence and advance release workflow after evidence passes
handoff.professor: approve exact public-facing video candidate when final review is required

storagePlan.repository: store only receipt, hash, URL and metadata unless the video is intentionally small and licensed for repository inclusion
